_doc: Figma variable <-> code token. Code is canonical for VALUES; this map records only the correspondence. Filled by hand from a live read, by whoever is doing the work — there is no skill that sweeps the file, because a scheduled sweep would imply an authority the design canvas does not have. See ../README.md. A variable with `code: null` is drift — Figma has a variable with no token behind it. Empty on day one, which is the honest state and not a gap.
